expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The bottom tab bar icons (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) sit too low and are clipped by the bottom edge of the screen. Only their upper portions are visible, and any labels are hidden, which makes the primary navigation hard to recognize and tap.
The system gesture handle (home indicator) is drawn directly over the Search and Orders tab icons. This obscures them and risks gesture conflicts when users try to tap those tabs.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 covers the bottom navigation clipping/labels cut off, and reported issue 1 covers the system gesture bar overlapping the tab icons.
